title: Incident Dataset Entry
description: One GenAI data security incident. Authoritative schema for datasets/incident_dataset/ (data_validation/schemas/incident.schema.json is a stub that points here). Every entry is either 'public' (a publicly disclosed incident: the affected organization may be named, and public sources are required) or 'anonymized' (for example a self-report: no organization names). See the dataset README for the full disclosure rule.

incident_id.description: INC- plus four digits; assigned on merge. Must match the file name.

title.description: One-line headline. For 'public' entries it may name the affected organization; for 'anonymized' entries it must not.

disclosure.description: 'public': the incident was publicly disclosed (advisory, regulator filing, research paper, reputable news report) and the organization is named there. 'anonymized': self-reported or otherwise non-public; no organization, person, or system names.

date.description: When the incident occurred or, if unknown, when it was first disclosed (ISO 8601 date). If only the month or year is known, use its first day and set 'precision'.

precision.description: How precise 'date' is. Omit when the exact day is known.

source.description: Free-text description of the source, e.g. 'Vendor security advisory' or 'Anonymized self-report'.

source_urls.description: Public, citable sources for the incident: primary sources (vendor advisory, regulator notice, the researchers' paper or write-up) preferred, reputable news otherwise. Required for 'public' entries.

affected_organizations.description: Organizations affected by or responsible for the incident, as named in source_urls. 'public' entries only. Never people, and never the contributor's own employer in any other role.

crosswalk_id.description: ID of the same incident in the crosswalk incident list (GenAI-Security-Project/crosswalk, data/incidents.json), if it is there.

contributor.description: Optional attribution. Per repository policy: the person's name plus, optionally, one ORCID iD; no affiliation, organization, or URL fields.
